entry.title: DocKitty Example
entry.summary: Master entry point for the example docsite built with DocKitty.
entry.content:
A minimal, deployable docsite that renders a DocKitty docs/ tree with @spec-kitty/doc-toolkit. It exists to show the convention in practice and to prove the generated artifacts:

  • /sitemap-index.xml — search-engine discovery
  • /rss.xml — subscribe to documentation changes
  • /llms.txt — the agent-facing index
  • /api/index.json — the machine-readable corpus map

Sections

Ordered for progressive disclosure (context → operations):

  • Context — why this exists and its domain vocabulary.
  • Architecture — current system design.
  • Decision Records — the immutable ADR log.
  • Guides — how-to for humans and agents.
  • Changelog — release history.

Only a subset of the twelve Common Docs sections is populated here; the rest (plans, api, configuration, integrations, security, operations, migrations) are scaffolded the same way with scaffold.mjs.

Quick reference

  • Run locally: pnpm --filter example dev
  • Build: pnpm --filter example build
  • See also: the repo README.md and its AGENTS.md.
